executor: GitHub Actions matrix, one repository per ubuntu-latest runner (run https://github.com/Mircoguidetti/fenvix-engine-cli/actions/runs/43931114732)
command: gh workflow run harness.yml -f runs=10 -f seeds=20 -f confirm=10
notes: The FlaPy dataset (Gruber et al.) is published on Zenodo, which the development environment cannot reach (HTTP 403 from the network proxy): the 'flaky' pool uses the Python section of IDoFT, each project pinned at the commit where its flaky tests were detected.

Selection: the first 25 candidates per pool (in harness/repos.json and harness/flaky_candidates.json order) that clone, install, collect and finish their first baseline run within 120 s; every rejected candidate is listed above.
